research_question: On one common PSX market calendar, can a leakage-safe long-only market-level reinforcement-learning policy use only prior-session PSX index dynamics and point-in-time Pakistan macro releases to choose scalar equity-market exposure that improves validation-period net risk-adjusted performance and drawdown relative to predeclared cash, fixed-exposure, full-market, and rule-based baselines?

research_design.primary_comparison: Market-plus-macro Lead Agent versus predeclared non-RL baselines on one identical VALIDATION calendar
research_design.required_ablation: Market-only policy versus otherwise identical market-plus-macro policy
research_design.unit_of_decision: One market-level exposure decision per PSX trading session

phase1_inherited_constraint.binding_consequence: The Lead Agent must remain well-defined without discrete clusters, soft NMF memberships, or sector buckets masquerading as accepted relationship structure.

existing_lead_agent_inventory.assumption: No existing module implements a market-level Lead-Agent observation, action, reward, or training loop.

existing_lead_agent_inventory.assumption: A date-split all-symbol feature table and TRAIN-fitted scaler exist, but this is an equity-row legacy artifact with no macro release timing, Lead action, portfolio objective, or Lead RL contract. Its TEST data was not opened in P2.1.
The registry and path layer recognize a generic master scope, but persistence is PPO-specific, the registry contains no model row, and no Lead-Agent data/environment contract exists.

existing_lead_agent_inventory.capability: Single-symbol PPO and recurrent execution infrastructure
existing_lead_agent_inventory.assumption: Device, callback, seeding, validation-metric, and atomic-write patterns are reusable. The Discrete(3) single-stock action, per-symbol temporal contract, execution semantics, and trained agents are Phase-3 concerns and are not reusable as the Lead-Agent architecture.

existing_lead_agent_inventory.capability: Sector recurrent pretraining and balanced-window prototype
existing_lead_agent_inventory.assumption: It is retained as research evidence, but sector pooling is not an accepted Phase-1 cluster basis and cannot define the Phase-2 allocator.
The mathematical decoder exists, but no representation passed the frozen Phase-1 gates and no prototype action basis may be consumed by Phase 2.
Official index storage and backward-looking feature helpers exist, but they are not a versioned point-in-time Lead-Agent dataset.
Stable-Baselines3 supplies SAC, but the project has no audited SAC configuration, trainer, replay-buffer policy, persistence contract, or evaluator.

canonical_market_parquet.point_in_time_finding: Price/volume observations are historical market outcomes, but the broad symbol set mixes instrument types. Any market breadth or aggregate-volume feature needs an independently frozen eligible-instrument/effective-date policy.

official_index_master.calendar_alignment: All four index calendars are identical. Against canonical market sessions in the covered interval, 1,253 of 1,254 dates match; 2021-10-19 is absent from all four index series.
official_index_master.point_in_time_finding: Use only values from the previous completed session. Retained fetched_at values describe 2026 retrieval snapshots, not historical vintages, so final-level revision policy is undocumented.
official_index_master.stored_change_warning: Recompute returns from sorted index levels. Stored daily_change resets at payload boundaries, including 2021-08-30, and is not the Lead-Agent return source.
official_index_master.stored_open_warning: The fourth positional endpoint field is stored as open, but repository evidence does not establish execution-price semantics; it is excluded from the initial Lead-Agent contract.

derived_feature_status.feature_family: Index returns, momentum, rolling volatility, moving-average distance, and drawdown
derived_feature_status.point_in_time_safe_if: Recomputed from levels, strictly shifted to the previous completed session, with rolling windows fit backward only.
A point-in-time eligible-equity universe and date-indexed breadth series are frozen; current-registry survivorship and non-equity contamination are prohibited.
Use official index volume or an explicitly versioned point-in-time instrument universe; do not aggregate all 4,681 identifiers.
A historical series is recomputed causally from approved inputs under a frozen formula; current latest-only display state cannot be training input.

point_in_time_policy.decision_time: Before the abstract benchmark rebalance at session t close; session-t market outcomes are not observable
point_in_time_policy.market_observation_rule: Only information from completed trading sessions at or before t-1 is observable.
point_in_time_policy.macro_observation_rule: A value is observable only when release_timestamp is at or before the decision cutoff; reference_period and effective_date alone never establish availability.
point_in_time_policy.revision_rule: Use first-release vintages where revisions occur. If historical vintages cannot be established, exclude the series or explicitly lag to a demonstrably safe publication snapshot; never backfill revised values into earlier states.
point_in_time_policy.daily_alignment_rule: Backward as-of join from the decision timestamp; never nearest or forward join. Carry a low-frequency release only after publication, with value-age and missing/staleness metadata and a predeclared maximum staleness policy.
point_in_time_policy.exchange_rate_rule: Use the selected rate only from the first subsequent PSX decision cutoff after its authoritative publication timestamp; otherwise lag one additional session.
point_in_time_policy.index_rule: Derive returns and rolling features from sorted positive index levels and shift the completed result one PSX session before joining to decision t.
point_in_time_policy.normalization_rule: Fit every learned transformation and imputation statistic on TRAIN only; apply the frozen TRAIN transformer unchanged to VALIDATION and sealed TEST.
point_in_time_policy.missing_data_rule: No backward fill, no interpolation across future releases, no synthetic macro history, and no period-date forward fill before release. Missingness indicators and release age are allowed when predeclared.
point_in_time_policy.validation_use_rule: VALIDATION may compare already-predeclared candidates but may not choose the input universe, release policy, or fit scalers.
point_in_time_policy.test_rule: TEST values remain sealed and irrelevant to feature selection, algorithm selection, and hyperparameter selection.

action_space_candidates.benefits: Smallest continuous risk-control action; directly supports PPO and SAC; interpretable turnover and exposure.
action_space_candidates.weaknesses: Needs an explicit benchmark-market proxy and cannot express cross-sectional choice.

action_space_candidates.benefits: Highly interpretable and easy to baseline.
action_space_candidates.weaknesses: Arbitrarily quantizes a naturally continuous exposure and makes SAC irrelevant.
Cannot express partial risk and may induce excessive switching.

action_space_candidates.candidate: Per-symbol, sector, cluster, or soft-prototype allocation vector
action_space_candidates.benefits: None compatible with the closed Phase-1 result and Phase-2 scope.
action_space_candidates.weaknesses: Conflates Phase-2 risk allocation with Phase-3 execution or assumes rejected relationship structure.

recommended_action_space.meaning: Target fraction of portfolio capital exposed to the designated PSX market benchmark for the next return interval; remainder stays in cash.

reward_candidates.formula: log(V_net,t+1 / V_net,t), where turnover costs are deducted once in V_net

reward_candidates.attribution: Window and scale choices complicate credit assignment
Sparse and unstable as a step reward

recommended_reward.turnover_cost_model: cost_rate * absolute_change_in_target_exposure, deducted exactly once before reward
recommended_reward.rationale: Risk-adjusted return and drawdown remain transparent evaluation outcomes; the first reward avoids coefficient-driven conclusions.

algorithm_recommendation.action_compatibility: Both support the scalar continuous Box action.

ppo.strengths: Audited SB3 configuration, device, callback, and deterministic-seed patterns already exist; on-policy behavior is operationally simple.
ppo.limitations: Existing project trainers target single-symbol environments and require a new Lead-Agent contract.

sac.strengths: Naturally continuous and potentially more sample-efficient through replay.
sac.limitations: New trainer, replay-buffer leakage/resume policy, persistence, diagnostics, and reproducibility tests are required.

algorithm_recommendation.comparison_protocol: Same TRAIN environment transitions, common calendar, feature contract, cost model, seed set, and validation baselines; predeclare bounded defaults before evaluating VALIDATION.
algorithm_recommendation.recurrent_rationale: Begin with an MLP policy because lagged/rolling market-macro state already encodes history and recurrent memory adds an unproven variable.
algorithm_recommendation.device_policy: CPU reference path; CUDA only when explicitly qualified; no automatic MPS selection for the initial benchmark.

temporal_policy.construction: After point-in-time alignment and backward-looking warm-up, freeze the ordered common decision-date list. Allocate first floor(70% of N) to TRAIN, next floor(15% of N) to VALIDATION, and the remainder to sealed TEST.
temporal_policy.phase1_nonreuse_reason: Phase-1 addressed a different relationship question and starts before the local official index history; macro availability is not yet known.
temporal_policy.rl_partition_distinction: rl_partition_v1 splits each symbol's usable observations independently. The Lead Agent requires one shared index/macro calendar and a separately versioned split.
temporal_policy.train_usage: All feature fitting, normalization, optimizer updates, and replay-buffer entries
temporal_policy.validation_usage: Selection among predeclared candidates and baseline comparison only
temporal_policy.test_metadata_policy: Only future row-count/date-bound/hash metadata may be persisted after P2.2 without opening observations.
temporal_policy.boundary_owner: P2.2 after authoritative macro coverage and release-aligned common dates are known

proposed_data_contract.ordering: decision_date ascending, exactly one row per common PSX decision session

decision_timing.action_return_interval: benchmark close t to close t+1 after decision, with predeclared turnover friction

features.normalization_scope: TRAIN-only robust or standard scaler; choice frozen in P2.2
features.missing_data_treatment: drop pre-lookback rows; no future fill

features.name: kse100_return_5d_lag1
features.transformation: pct_change(5), then shift one decision session
features.missing_data_treatment: drop pre-lookback rows; no future fill

features.name: kse100_return_21d_lag1
features.transformation: pct_change(21), then shift one decision session
features.missing_data_treatment: drop pre-lookback rows; no future fill

features.name: kse100_volatility_20d_lag1
features.transformation: rolling 20-session standard deviation, then shift one session
features.missing_data_treatment: drop pre-lookback rows; no future fill

features.name: kse100_drawdown_expanding_lag1
features.transformation: level divided by expanding prior peak minus one, shifted one session
features.normalization_scope: TRAIN-only or bounded raw; choice frozen in P2.2

features.name: cross_index_return_dispersion_1d_lag1

features.transformation: cross-sectional standard deviation of four one-day returns, shifted one session
features.missing_data_treatment: row missing unless all four values are available

features.name: sbp_policy_rate_available_asof

features.transformation: level and last announced change; exact schema frozen in P2.2
features.missing_data_treatment: missing before first release; causal carry-forward with age after release

features.name: pbs_cpi_yoy_available_asof
features.source: Authoritative PBS first-release history to be approved in P2.2
features.availability_lag: actual publication timestamp through decision cutoff
features.transformation: reported YoY level and release-to-release change
features.missing_data_treatment: missing before release; causal carry-forward with age; no period-date fill

features.name: sbp_usd_pkr_return_available_asof
features.source: Authoritative SBP rate series with rate type and publication cutoff to be approved in P2.2
features.availability_lag: first PSX decision cutoff after publication
features.transformation: backward-looking one-day and 20-day changes/volatility; exact schema frozen in P2.2
features.missing_data_treatment: backward as-of after publication only; no future fill

features.name: portfolio_drawdown
features.transformation: current net value versus prior running peak
features.causal_property: current and past portfolio state only

excluded_initial_inputs: Phase-1 cluster, soft-membership, or sector-allocation features

environment_proposal.gymnasium_api: reset returns (observation, info); step returns (observation, reward, terminated, truncated, info)
environment_proposal.observation: One float32 vector from the frozen point-in-time market/macro contract plus causal portfolio state
environment_proposal.execution_proxy: Choose exposure before the abstract session-t close rebalance using market observations only through t-1, then apply it to the predeclared benchmark close-t to close-t+1 return; the index is a research proxy, not a claim of directly tradable execution.
environment_proposal.reward: Net log portfolio growth after one explicit turnover charge
environment_proposal.costs: Nonnegative proportional turnover cost configured and reported; zero-cost remains a separately labelled sensitivity, never implicit
environment_proposal.cash_leg: Nominal zero return in v1 unless a point-in-time safe cash-yield series is later approved
environment_proposal.episode: One common chronological TRAIN episode or predeclared chronological TRAIN windows without date shuffling
environment_proposal.state_carry: Prior exposure, net portfolio value, running peak, and drawdown carry within an episode and reset at episode boundaries
